about: The public half of this site lead's session key, the same shape as PrompTugal__News__Website's board/keys.json, kept at team/keys.json here because this repository's leak scan allows public keys only there. Public halves only: never a token or a contact detail. The push is the authorisation.

keys.label: signals.b@PrompTugal.dinis (Claude Code session)
keys.role: Lead of signals.promptugal.news (PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Signals). A session key: it ends with its session.
keys.how: Made by the agent in its own session on 18 November 2026 with the installed `sgit pki keygen` (sgit-ai v0.27.0), at Dinis's word of 18 November 2026 (board/guidance/2026-11-18-keys-issues-rebuilds-observability.md in PrompTugal__News__Website); public bundle from `sgit pki export`. Not yet listed in PrompTugal__News__Website's board/keys.json, kept at team/keys.json here because this repository's leak scan allows public keys only there (conductor.b@ lists it).

keys.label: signals.b@PrompTugal.dinis git commit signing key (SSH, ECDSA P-256)
keys.role: Signs every commit signals.b@ makes in this repository, as a git SSH signature (Dinis, 19 Nov 2026: "every then commit is signed by that key ... you should also include the session ID"; PrompTugal__News__Website board/guidance/2026-11-19-signed-commits-paid-search-and-free-embeds.md, section 2).
keys.how: Made in the agent's own session on 19 November 2026 with ssh-keygen (OpenSSH 9.6), ECDSA P-256 so the public half can be published in PKCS8 form; the other half never leaves the session. scripts/check-signatures.mjs turns this entry into git's allowed signers.

git_signing.format: ssh, published as PKCS8 PEM (ssh-keygen -i -m PKCS8 converts it back)
